text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're about halfway through summer
camp...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's run, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... Yeah, let's run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: See ya soon, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two run off side by side,
as if they're
both on
cloud nine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fsshhh, fsshhh...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri, there's somethin' I wanna ask ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whatcha racin' for? Does it got
somethin' to do with you bein' from the
boonies? Are ya tryin' to
show everyone
you're just as good as the rest?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Show them I'm just as good, huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I don't... think that's it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I just want to do my best for the people 
supporting me in my hometown. They
cheer me
on from afar, and I treasure
them very much.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You treasure 'em, huh... So that's how it
is. Yeah, I
can relate to that.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But... if ya treasure 'em so much,
don'tcha wanna be with 'em back home?
Y'know, instead of bein'
out here in the
central scene.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've never felt that way. I have no
intention of
quitting races and going
back to my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? How come?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because me winning in the central races
is
everybody's dream.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They've all bet their dreams on me.
They're crossing their fingers for me,
hoping I'll win and
become a star
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't fulfill those dreams back home. If
I return
now, it'll never happen.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why running in the Twinkle Series
is so
important to me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So your dream... is to run.
I get it now...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Oguri... You 'n me are real similar after
all. I'm
runnin' for my family, and you're
runnin' for your
hometown.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(But while I was here frettin', you were
busy
overtakin' me.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Y'know, I understand what ya mean
when ya say
that it's everyone's dream to
see ya run...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oguri, can I ask ya one more thing? I'm
not sure
why, but seein' ya race gets my
heart thumpin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
What're ya thinkin' about when you're
runnin'
down that final stretch?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
On the final stretch... there's nothing on
my mind.
In those last moments...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm empty. By then, I've got nothing left.
I'm so
empty I can barely run anymore...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But that's when...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see their faces. Shige, Chiyo,
Yoshi—everyone
who came to see me
off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They've given me so much food and
cheered me on every step of the way... I
just want to do
whatever it takes to live
up to their support.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That thought relights the fire... in my
heart, my
stomach, and all the way to
the tips of my toes...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And then I start running again. My body
gets its
second wind somehow.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have the power they've
given me... I
can't lose.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya mean... ya burn out mid-race, but
then bounce
right back?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
So that's why your races are so
excitin'...
No, the
real takeaway here is...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Her determination to return the favor is
so strong that it lifts her up when she's
got nothin'
left to give. That's her
secret...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I see it now... We seem similar, but we're
not.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're my total opposite.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I am?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. See, you stock up on strength by
eatin', so
to speak. You fill up on all the
food and support ya get from the
people close to ya...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But I'm the opposite. My strength comes from hunger. It's like, "Even though I can't eat, l'm still gonna eat it!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
We've both seen the same struggles, but
we're handlin' 'em in our own way. I
dunno if it's our
personalities, or if this is just one big
coincidence...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But yeah, Oguri, you're...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(You're like another me. The me I coulda
been in
some other reality or
somethin'...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(Someone that had all the support in the
world,
even though they were poor. In
other words...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(The exact Umamusume I dreamed of
becomin' as
a kid.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it all makes sense now... No
wonder ya
grabbed my attention...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're... a special case.
I can't just slink
off from
ya with my tail tucked between
my legs.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
If it's you we're talkin' about, then I
gotta run no
matter what. Plus, we gotta
settle this once 'n for
all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama... I'm glad you feel that way.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: (I wanna run right now! I wanna run with her! And I just gotta win!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(But... now's not the time. Just gotta be
patient a
li'l longer.)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But that reminds me. Oguri, you still got
the
Classics to get through.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
First things first, go for gold at the
Kikuka Sho. I
know ya got it in ya...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's the matter, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I won't be running in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Why not? Oh, yeah. You're better with
shorter
distances, right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That is true, but it's not about that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The reason I'm not going to the Kikuka
Sho is...
Well, because...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You won't be there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've been wondering since last summer...
Maybe
even before that, actually.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I was wondering... just how tenacious you
could
be. And how strong you'd become.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
And just how much more I'd respect you
then. I never would have met an
Umamusume like you
back in my
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but want to race with you.
And the
sooner that happens, the
better.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So I'm not going to race in the Kikuka
Sho. I'll run
in the autumn Tenno Sho
instead. And that's
because...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I want to beat you, Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oguri... Y-you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're just so...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, am I... bothering you? I'm
sorry, Tama.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Damn right you're botherin' me! The idea of you hoppin' on the autumn Tenno Sho train...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Is da most excitin' thing I coulda asked
for! Dis
ROCKS! Ya finally came out 'n
said it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But if that's how ya feel, just try to imagine how I'm feelin'! How am I s'posed to wait till fall?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're my one 'n only rival! The junior
hot on my
trail, chasin' after her goal.
You're da whole
package!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Tama...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up. You better come at me with
all ya got
this year! I'm settin' up autumn
'n winter as the
stages for our showdown!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You bein' a classic-year runner don't
mean a
thing. Gimme everythin' ya got!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Cause I'm gonna take all dat 'n send it
right back
atcha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Sure thing, Tama. I'm really glad I
opened up to
you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, Tamamo Cross shares the
details of
their talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Two massive dreams are about to
collide, and
from that, a dazzling drama
will surely unfold.
